Recover an old Argonian's priceless keepsake.
Hands-That-Heal has lost a wooden box with great sentimental value to him after being attacked by hackwings. He's offered a reward if I successfully return the box to him.
The wooden box doesn't physically open when looting the branch from it.
The box was last seen being carried away by a hackwing. Hands-That-Heal believes it can be found in a nearby nest. Investigate Hackwing Nest

Though I couldn't find the wooden box within the hackwing's nest, I did find several signs of a hunting party. Perhaps Hands-That-Heal will know more about this hunting party and where I could find them. Talk to Hands-That-Heal
Hands-That-Heal has identified the hunting party as being part of the Root-House people. I should seek their campsite and see if they found the wooden box. Find the Root-House Camp
I've found the Root-House tribe's campsite. I should speak to one of their members and find out if they've seen Hands-That-Heal's wooden box. Talk to Tem-Tei
Tem-Tei has the wooden box, but won't part with it for free. If I'm to be given the box, I must enter the Blackguard's campsite and steal back her hunting bow. Retrieve Hunting Bow
Now that I've collected the hunting bow, I should talk to Tem-Tei about the wooden box. Talk to Tem-Tei
Tem-Tei has agreed to give me the branch within the wooden box. I should collect it so it can be returned to Hands-That-Heal. Collect the Branch
Now that I found the branch, I should meet up with Hands-that-Heal and return it to him. He should be in Bright-Throat Village by now. Travel to Bright-Throat Village
I've found Hands-That-Heal in the Bright-Throat Village. I should give him the branch. Talk to Hands-That-Heal
Hands-That-Heal has requested that I bury the branch beneath the Bright-Throat Village Hist Tree. He believes this may help him one day be reunited with his village's people. Bury the Branch
I've buried the branch beneath the Bright-Throat's Hist Tree. I should speak to Hands-That-Heal about my reward. Talk to Hands-That-Heal
Find out what the Waking Flame is doing in Fargrave
You have been summoned to Fargrave, a strange city in Oblivion.
Band of the Anchorite 1 Skill Point vh Gold

Lyranth the Dremora sent me a letter. She wants me to meet her in Fargrave, a city somewhere in the depths of Oblivion. Apparently, the Order of the Waking Flame is up to something that threatens both Fargrave and Nirn.
Sister Celdina may linger on the platform after destroying the runes, instead of fleeing like the Anchorite mentions in her dialogue.

Lyranth the Dremora wants me to meet her in Fargrave, a city in Oblivion, so I can help her determine the scope of the threat posed by the Mehrunes Dagon cult, the Order of the Waking Flame. She should be waiting outside the city's southern gate. Meet Lyranth in Fargrave
Lyranth isn't here, but I saw a person take down a Waking Flame cultist. Then both her hands and mine began to glow. I should talk to her and find out what's going on here. Talk to the Anchorite

The Anchorite wants me to talk to Madam Whim at the House of Whims in Fargrave and Initiate Tilgo in the Deadlands to see what they know about Lyranth, the votive runes, or the Order of the Waking Flame. Talk to Initiate Tilgo Talk to Madam Whim
I should go to the Fargrave Crafting Plaza and find the Anchorite. I need to let her know what I learned from Madam Whim and Initiate Tilgo. Go to the Fargrave Crafting Plaza
I arrived at the Fargrave Crafting Plaza. Now I should talk to the Anchorite and tell her what I learned from Madam Whim and Initiate Tilgo. Talk to The Anchorite

The Anchorite thinks that the cult leader, Sister Celdina, might be using the old baths in the Shambles as a headquarters. Since Lyranth seems to be hunting her, we might find her there. So it's time to head into the Shambles. Go to the Shambles

We entered the area known as the Shambles. Now to make our way to the old bathhouse. The Anchorite suggested three paths we could take: the western warrens, through the central plazas, or east through Skein Row. Reach the Bathhouse Explore the Shambles
We reached the bathhouse. I should check the door and see if it's unlocked. Inspect the Bathhouse Door

The main door to the bathhouse is locked with some sort of magic, but the Anchorite believes there may be another way in. I should search the area and see if I can find a way into the courtyard. Find a Way Into the Bathhouse Courtyard
We made it into the courtyard. I should search the area and see if I can find a way into the bathhouse from here. Search the Courtyard Talk to The Anchorite
We located a cave entrance into the bathhouse undercroft. I should explore the area and look for a way to enter the bathhouse proper through the undercroft. Explore the Bathhouse Undercroft
We found another door, but it's protected by a ward of some sort. I should discuss our options with the Anchorite. Talk to the Anchorite

The Anchorite wants me to find a lucent, charge it in a dynamus font, and then place the charged crystal on the discharge labrum beside the door. She says this will release the energy and dispel the ward. Dispel the Ward Find a Lucent Take the Lucent Find a Dynamus Font Charge the Lucent Return to Door Place the Charged Lucent
Now that the ward has been dealt with, we should see what's beyond the door as we make our way to the bathhouse. Continue on Toward the Bathhouse
We found Lyranth as we were making our way into the old bathhouse. I should talk to her. Talk to Lyranth
Now that the Anchorite and I have met up with Lyranth the Dremora, we can accompany her into the old bathhouse and look for the cult leader, Sister Celdina. Find Sister Celdina

We encountered Sister Celdina in the middle of casting some sort of powerful spell. I need to find a way to disrupt the ritual. Lyranth suggested I destroy the votive runes positioned around the chamber. Disrupt Sister Celdina's Ritual: 0/3
I stopped Sister Celdina's ritual before it could be unleashed on Fargrave, but she got away. I should follow Lyranth into the bathhouse. Enter the Bathhouse
I should talk to Lyranth and see what she thinks we should do now. Talk to Lyranth
Sister Celdina escaped, but Lyranth thinks she may have left something behind that will help us locate her. I should search the bathhouse and see what I can find. Search the Bathhouse
I found a note written in a language or code I don't understand. I should show the note to Lyranth. Maybe she can decipher it. Talk to Lyranth

Lyranth suggested we leave the bathhouse and return to Fargrave before the cult returns in force. The Anchorite suggested we meet at Fargrave's inn, the Bearer's Rest. I should head there now. Meet at the Bearer's Rest
I made it to the Bearer's Rest, the inn in Fargrave. Now I should find the Anchorite and see if she knows of anyone in the city who can decipher the encoded note we found. Talk to the Anchorite
Save what remains of Murcien's Hamlet
Help the Evermore guard defend a village from Reachmen raiders.
Murcien's Hamlet - Help the Evermore Troops at Murcien's Hamlet
Sergeant Eubella Bruhl on the east road; Kahaba on the west road; Squire Theo Rocque at the docks
Soldiers from Evermore were defeated at Murcien's Hamlet by a Reachman attack.
Theo's dialogue audio that triggers from outside the house after finding the totem won't play to match the subtitles when returning to him.
I need to locate Squire Theo at the docks to learn how I can help the village. Talk to Squire Theo Rocque

I have arrived at Murcien's Hamlet to find Squire Theo Rocque in charge. He's asked me to wait a moment while he speaks with one of the village elders. Learn What Happened in Murcien's Hamlet Squire Theo Rocque is speaking to a village elder by the name of Medya Zurric. I should let them finish speaking. Listen to Theo and Medya Zurric Appears once Theo and Medya have finished speaking Squire Theo Rocque is done speaking with Medya Zurric and I should speak with him. Talk to Theo

I should inspect the fortifications at Murcien's Hamlet to make sure they are reasonably intact while Theo checks on Sir Etienne Hu. Check the Fortifications: 0/2 I should visit the fortifications on the west side. Check the Western Fortifications Reachmen are attacking the fortifications on the west side. I should keep them from breaking through the defenses. Defend the Western Fortifications I should visit the fortifications on the east side. Check the Eastern Fortifications I should look nearby the fortifications for some water to put the fire out with. Grab a Bucket of Water I should put the fire out at the fortifications now that I have a bucket of water. Put out the Fire I've put out the fire at the east fortifications.
Squire Theo called for my help. He mentioned that he would be at Medya Zurric's home checking on Sir Etienne Hu. I should look for him there. Talk to Theo

Squire Theo Rocque asked me to search Medya Zurric's home to see what has happened to Sir Etienne. I should look around for clues. Investigate Sir Etienne's Fate Check on Sir Etienne Hu Sir Etienne has been murdered. I should investigate Medya Zurric's home for clues. Search Medya Zurric's Home for Clues Examine Disrupted Dining Area Examine Fallen Book Examine Bloody Wash Basin
Now that I've searched Medya Zurric's home, I should speak with Squire Theo Rocque. Talk to Theo
Medya's no longer in her home. I should speak to Medya's apprentice, Rolbert Foucher. He's on the docks with the others. Talk to Rolbert Foucher
I need to search the Hamlet for Medya as she may be in danger, just as Sir Etienne was. I should search inside the homes for her or for any clues which might help me find her. Search Inside Houses
A letter inside one of the homes indicated that Medya goes to a specific site at night, but that nobody knows what she does there. I should look for her there. Find the Site Medya Visits
I should return to Squire Theo Rocque at Medya Zurric's house. I've been gone long enough, and he may be in danger himself. Talk to Theo
Medya Zurric's son Labhraidh has come to her defense. I must defeat him before she can be brought to justice for allowing Sir Etienne Hu to die. Defeat Labhraidh
When confronted about her Reachman son, Medya Zurric refused to treat Sir Etienne Hu, allowing him to die. Now her fate must be decided. Bring Medya Zurric to Justice
If Medya stands trial Medya Zurric will stand trial in Evermore for her actions. I should speak to Squire Theo to find out what will happen next to Murcien's Hamlet. Talk to Theo
If Medya dies Medya Zurric has been put to death for her actions. I should speak to Squire Theo to find out what will happen next to Murcien's Hamlet. Talk to Theo

The Reaver Citadel, Reaver Citadel Pyramid
Bulwark of the Citadel vh Gold
King Dynar has devised a two-pronged attack to take control of the Reaver Citadel. It utilizes the old Fighters and Mages Guilds' halls located in this ancient Nirn city.

Although inaccessible beforehand, during the quest, the Mages Guild hall doesn't appear warded and is accessible early, unlike the Fighters Guild hall, despite what is stated by King Laloriaran Dynar at the start of the quest.
The ward on the pyramid door is removed and access is granted upon exiting dialogue with Lyranth rather than after she performs her ritual.

While the Fighters Guild troops use the secret passageways to enter the Fighters Guild hall, I need to find the ward key and deactivate the wards that seal the hall. But first, I'll need to find my own way into the city. Collect Fighters Guild Ward Key Find a Way Into the Citadel Talk to Lyranth
I recovered the Fighters Guild Ward Key. Now I should use it to deactivate the wards and open the guild hall door. Deactivate the Guild Hall Wards
Now that the wards are down and the fighters are here, I should talk to King Laloriaran Dynar and find out what I need to do next. Talk to King Laloriaran Dynar in the Fighters Guild Hall
While the Fighters Guild battles the Dremora, I need to go to the upper city and locate the Mages Guild portal stones. Go to the Upper City Talk to Lyranth
In order to activate the portal in the Mages Guild Hall, I need to collect the scattered portal stones. Collect Portal Stones: 0/4

Once I set the portal stones back in place, the mages should be able to activate the guild hall portal. Restore the Portal Stones: 0/4 Now that I collected the portal stones, I should enter the Mages Guild Hall. Enter the Mages Guild Hall
Now that the Mages Guild Hall portal has been activated and the mages have teleported through, I should talk to Vanus Galerion. Talk to Vanus Galerion
I need find the entrance to the pyramid so I can confront the leader of the citadel and obtain the key to the Labyrinth. Find the Pyramid Entrance
I reached the entrance to the pyramid, but others have arrived before me, including the Dremora, Lyranth. I should talk to her. Talk to Lyranth
Now that Lyranth opened the door, I should enter Valkynaz Seris' stronghold and confront the commander of the Citadel. Enter the Pyramid
I entered the pyramid stronghold of Valkynaz Seris. Now I need to find the Valkynaz and end this. Defeat Enemies in the Stronghold

The stronghold is clear, and Valkynaz Seris is dead. I should find the key to the Labyrinth. We'll need that key to enter Molag Bal's inner sanctum. Perhaps the key is in the Valkynaz's chest. Find the Labyrinth Key Talk to Lyranth
I collected the key that opens the way to the Labyrinth. Now I should exit the pyramid and find Vanus Galerion. Find Vanus Galerion

With Lyranth now in charge of the Citadel, we have safe passage to the Labyrinth and the Endless Stair beyond. And I have the key that gets us inside. I should speak to Vanus Galerion and see how he and King Dynar want to proceed. Talk to Vanus Galerion

Help the Arenthian resistance drive out the Colovians.
Arenthia - Aid Cariel and the Arenthian Resistance.
Leathers of the Emancipator Colovian Uniform (Page) vh Gold
The town of Arenthia has been occupied by a Colovian force. I've been tapped to help retake the city alongside a Khajiiti resistance force.

The interaction prompt of the coffer containing the illusion crystal is misaligned due to the lootable desk it sits upon causing prompt overlap. You must aim above or to the sides of the coffer to make its prompt appear.

While displayed as a mandatory objective, it's possible to bring Centurion Gavo over to the hideout without equipping the earring of disguise. Once in the hideout, the objective completes and transitions to the next.

Cariel has asked me to find one of the projections in Arenthia and listen to what it's saying. She thinks it will help me understand what we're up against here. Listen to a Magical Projection Cariel wants me to grab a uniform from the Colovian soldier she took out. It will allow me to move around Arenthia unnoticed. Obtain a Uniform

I saw Lavinia's speech to the Arenthians. Cariel told me to head to one of the huts in the market to meet up with the resistance. I'll know it by the statue of a lion at the base of the stair. Talk to Kazirra

Clan Mother Kazirra and Cariel have a plan to destabilize the Colovian hold on Arenthia. Key to this is finding a man named Centurion Gavo and making him talk. I'll have to search the Tower district of Arenthia for correspondence with the Centurion. Search the Tower District: 0/4 Search for Evidence Take the Crystal
I've found a number of letters and notes concerning Centurion Gavo. Kazirra told me to meet up with Cariel behind the titular tower at the back of the district. Meet Cariel Behind the Tower
Cariel has a plan to catch Gavo. She needs me to distract him up in the tower. I'll need to enter the tower and wait for him to arrive. Enter the Tower

I should wait for Gavo to enter the tower. Wait for Gavo Cariel told me that Gavo would be coming from the direction of the district's gate. I can watch out the tower to see him coming. Watch for Gavo Coming From the Gate
Gavo has finally arrived. I need to speak with him until Cariel arrives to take him out. Talk to Gavo
Cariel was able to sneak into the tower and knock Gavo unconscious. I should speak to her about our next move. Talk to Cariel
Cariel gave me an earring that will disguise me as Gavo. Cariel will dress Gavo as my prisoner. I should wait for her to finish her work. Wait for Cariel to Prepare Gavo Wear the Earring
Gavo and I are both disguised. I should be able to walk him right out the front gate of the Tower district, back to Kazirra's hideout. Return to Kazirra With Gavo
I'm back among the resistance. I should speak to Kazirra about what to do with Gavo. Talk to Kazirra
Kazirra is going to interrogate Gavo and wants me to imprint his confession on the crystal I recovered. I'll need to use the crystal on Gavo. Use Crystal on Gavo
I must listen as Kazirra interrogates Gavo. Witness the Confession
Now that we have Gavo's confession imprinted, I should speak to Kazirra about what she plans to do with it. Talk to Kazirra

To change the projections scattered around Arenthia, I just have to use the crystal I recovered. It should change the illusions to show Gavo's confession instead of Lavinia's speech. Changing one projection should change the rest. Imprint Projections Attune Projection
Lavinia's speech is over, and the Colovians will soon learn the truth about the connection to the Stonefire cult. Cariel wants me to kill General Lavinia, and end their hold on Arenthia. Kill Lavinia

Lavinia is dead. I should find Cariel and Kazirra and speak to them. Return to the Town Center Some of Kazirra's resistance fighters have captured a Colovian, who seems to have surrendered. I could speak to him. Talk to Captured Colovian Soldier
Lavinia is dead. I should find Cariel and Kazirra and speak to them. Talk to Cariel
Both "Stomp" and "Sweep Shockwave" have no indicators.
The Covetous Damned constantly tries to cast a "Sweep" ability, to no success.
Ascend the Crystal Tower and put an end to Nocturnal's machinations.
Staff of the Crystal Tower Mystic Eye Psijic Cuirass 1 Skill Point s Gold

I negotiated an alliance of sorts with Clavicus Vile and Mephala. They agreed to help us get into the Crystal Tower-mostly. Once inside, I need to find a way to stop Nocturnal before she uses the tower to remake reality.
Thanks for giving us a fighting chance.
:"I should be thanking you. You had no reason to trust me, yet you did. And you gave me a chance to see my wife... to reconcile with her in a way. Now, go and beat Nocturnal. I have faith in you!"
After everything you did, this end is too good for you.

:"Yes, that's the spirit! Show me the anger you've been hiding! I'm fading away quickly, while you're about to suffer an eternity at Nocturnal's hands. Regardless, I must thank you. You gave me a chance. You let me see Valsirenn one last time"
Darien Gautier retains his follower icon even after he stops following you while he stays at the ballista while you gather the missing parts.
After crossing the gate that Leythen holds, Darien gets to the other side with you but he clips through the closing gate as he does so.
Sotha Sil has asked to speak with me. I should go to his study in Ceporah Tower and talk to him. Talk to Sotha Sil
Before heading to the Dreaming Cave, I should speak to my companions around the island. This might be my last chance to speak to them before we assault the Crystal Tower. Talk to Your Companions
Sotha Sil said to meet him in the Dreaming Cave. Enter the Dreaming Cave
Sotha Sil wants me to speak to him when I'm ready to start the assault on the Crystal Tower. Talk to Sotha Sil
Sotha Sil has opened a path for Mephala into the Dreaming Cave. I should observe what happens. Attend the Meeting in the Dreaming Cave
Mephala stepped out of the Dreaming Cave and called me forward. I should speak to the Daedric Prince. Talk to Mephala
Mephala forged the two Resolute Diamonds into a single gem that serves as both an anchor and a key. I should wait while the portal to Clavicus Vile's realm opens. Wait for the Portal to Reset
I should follow Barbas to Clavicus Vile's realm so he can show us the way to the Crystal Tower. Follow Barbas into the Fields of Regret
Despite our agreement with Clavicus Vile, it looks like we're going to have to fight our way to the Crystal Tower. Reach the Entrance of the Crystal Tower
Barbas wants to talk to me. I should see what he has to say. Talk to Barbas
The Resolute Anchor serves as both a key to the Crystal Tower and an anchor to our reality. Since I have it, we should be able to enter the Crystal Tower. Enter the Crystal Tower
We need to reach the top of the Crystal Tower to confront Nocturnal. Ascend the Crystal Tower
A Sapiarch, and she's still alive. I should talk to her. Talk to the Sapiarch
The dying Sapiarch mentioned a broken ballista. If I can find it and repair it, I might be able to use it to clear the debris that's blocking the path up the tower. Find the Broken Ballista
The ballista isn't broken, it just needs to be reassembled. I should locate the missing pieces so Darien can put it back together. Find the Missing Pieces to the Ballista
I gathered the parts to repair the ballista. I need to bring them back to Darien so he can put the siege engine into working order. Bring the Ballista Parts to Darien
The ballista is ready. I should be able to use it to open the way forward now. Use the Ballista on the Blocked Passage
We need to ascend the tower to confront Nocturnal. Ascend the Crystal Tower
This appears to be the tower's library. We need to find a way to move forward. Find a Way Through the Library Find the Key to the Pedestal
The library's gate is closed. We need to find a way through it if we want to continue. Open the Library Gate
Leythen seems to know how this gate mechanism works. I should talk to him. Talk to Earl Leythen
Leythen managed to get the gate open. Now we just have to get behind it before his magic fades. Get Through the Opened Gate
Leythen wasn't able to get through the gate before it closed. I should talk to him. Talk to Earl Leythen
Our only way is up. We need to find our way to stop Nocturnal. Ascend the Tower
Nocturnal's champion stands in our way with the corrupted Dawnbreaker sword. We need to stop her before we can continue Defeat Nocturnal's Champion
We retrieved the Dawnbreaker sword, but it has been corrupted by Nocturnal. I should talk to Darien to see if he can restore the blade. Talk to Darien Gautier
We need to find a way to cleanse the Dawnbreaker. Cleanse the Dawnbreaker
Darien sacrificed himself to restore the power of the Dawnbreaker. I should retrieve the restored sword. Take the Restored Dawnbreaker
I have the Dawnbreaker in my possession. The only thing left is to climb the tower and confront Nocturnal once and for all. Use the Dawnbreaker to Confront Nocturnal
I need to put a stop to Nocturnal and use the Dawnbreaker on the tower crystal when the time is right. Stop Nocturnal
Nocturnal is weakened. I need to use the Dawnbreaker on the crystal called Transparent Law before she can recover. Reforge Transparent Law

Nocturnal has been banished. The Transparent Law crystal has been restored, and for now, it seems the threat has ended. Valsirenn has been able to get into the tower though, so I should speak to her and find out what's happening. Talk to Valsirenn
We stopped Nocturnal. We should leave and let the others know of our success. Leave the Crystal Tower
Sotha Sil awaits. I should speak to him and tell him of our success. Talk to Sotha Sil
Accept the first larceny task from the Tip Board inside the Den.
Prove to the Guild that you know your way around other people's pockets.
Small Laundered Shipment s Gold 5 TG
Before the Thieves Guild sends me after more lucrative targets, I need to prove I know how to pick pockets.

I can prove I'm a discerning pickpocket by nabbing a few personal items, or an industrious pickpocket by taking a lot of treasures. I was recommended to look for targets in Abah's Landing, but I can technically pickpocket anyone in Hew's Bane. Pickpocket Any Treasures in Hew's Bane: 0/10
I have what I need. I should meet Kari in the Abah's Landing Thieves Den and inform her of my success. Meet Kari in the Thieves Den
Dragonguard Sanctum, New Moon Fortress, Dragonhold
Aeonstone Weave 1 Skill Point h Gold Regal Dragon Imp (Non-Combat Pet)
Sai Sahan received a letter from Abnur Tharn. It seems the old battlemage discovered something about a threat to Southern Elsweyr and needs our help.

Abnur Tharn may not appear on the balcony or by the tapestry when you must speak with him, impeding progress of the quest. Reentering the area via nearby doors and relogging in previous area or dying and respawning will usually cause him to spawn.

During the scene where Abnur Tharn injures and drives away Joorahmaar, it is possible for Joorahmaar to continue flying around and then leaving the area early, before Abnur blasts him with magic, resulting in the scene being incomplete.
The portal that Abnur Tharn conjures for you to escape may appear invisible.
I need to return to the Dragonguard Sanctum and talk to Sai Sahan. Talk to Sai Sahan
Nahfahlaar has been on edge lately. Sai Sahan wants me to learn what's wrong with him. Talk to Nahfahlaar
Sai Sahan asked me to investigate the strange portal that appeared in the Dragonguard Sanctum. Investigate the Portal
Abnur Tharn and Khamira emerged from the portal. I should talk to Abnur and find out why he brought us all together. Talk to Abnur Tharn Talk to Khamira

Abnur Tharn believes Kaalgrontiid is preparing to ascend to godhood on an island off Elweyr's southern coast, but powerful magic protects the place. We need to go to the New Moon Fortress and determine how the cultists travel to and from the island. Go to the New Moon Fortress Talk to Caska
Sai Sahan and Abnur Tharn arrived before me, but Tharn doesn't look well. I should talk to Sai. Talk to Sai Sahan

We think the amphitheater where the cult collects the aeonstone might contain a clue as to how they reach the island, but the entrance we used last time is sealed. We need to find another way inside. Find a Way Inside
Sai Sahan and I discovered a second entrance into the New Moon Fortress. I should see if it leads to the amphitheater. Enter the New Moon Fortress
We entered the New Moon Fortress. I should head for the amphitheater and determine if the cultists possess a method for reaching Kaalgrontiid's island. Go to the Amphitheater
While searching for the amphitheater, we heard Kaalgrontiid address his followers. We should attempt to locate the Dragon before he escapes. Find Kaalgrontiid
We found Kaalgrontiid in the New Moon Fortress. We should confront him. Confront Kaalgrontiid
Kaalgrontiid flew off before we could confront him, but he used a portal to send his cultists to the island. I should speak to Abnur Tharn and see if he can open the portal. Talk to Abnur Tharn

Abnur Tharn wants me to approach the aeonstones and allow them to absorb some of my life energy. That should provide the power he needs to activate the portal to Dragonhold. Approach the Aeonstones: 0/3
I should wait while Tharn uses the energized aeonstones to open the portal to Kaalgrontiid's island, Dragonhold. Wait for Tharn to Open the Portal

Abnur Tharn opened the portal to Dragonhold. We need to enter the portal and find a way to lower the island's defenses so that the rest of the Dragonguard can join us there. Enter the Portal to Dragonhold
The portal that Abnur Tharn opened deposited us in an ancient structure of some sort. I should speak to Tharn and see how he wants us to proceed. Talk to Abnur Tharn
We need to explore these ancient ruins and find a way to lower the aegis, the magical defenses that protect the island of Dragonhold. Explore the Ancient Ruins
We found a tapestry within the ancient ruins and Tharn wants to examine it. I should ask him if his examination yielded any important information. Talk to Abnur Tharn
We need to continue to explore these ancient ruins and find the aegis, the source of the magic that's protecting this island. Explore the Ancient Ruins

The Dragon Joorahmaar ordered the cultists to keep feeding the ritual sites. Finding the source of the magic protecting the island needs to wait. The ritual sites must be destroyed. Disrupt the Ritual Sites: 0/2 Disrupt the Ritual Sites Fight the Ritual Event
I destroyed the ritual sites. Now I need to continue my search for the aegis, the source of the magic that protects Dragonhold. Explore the Ancient Ruins
Abnur Tharn and I attracted the attention of one of Kaalgrontiid's Dragons. I should protect Tharn while he deals with the Dragon Joorahmaar. Wait for Abnur Tharn
Tharn used the energy he absorbed to drive off the Dragon Joorahmaar. I should find out if he's all right and see what he thinks we should do next. Talk to Abnur Tharn
Tharn thinks the wounded Dragon will lead us to the aegis, the source of Dragonhold's defenses. We should follow it and see where it leads. Find the Aegis
We discovered another tapestry. I should talk to Abnur Tharn and see what he makes of the images it depicts. Talk to Abnur Tharn

Something is happening to Dragonhold. The tremors strike with more regularity and intensity. We need to find the aegis, the source of the island's defenses, and destroy it while we still can. Find the Aegis

The wounded Dragon Joorahmaar guards the aegis. I need to deal with the Dragon while Tharn attempts to destroy the aegis and lower the island's defenses. Then we can worry about Kaalgrontiid. Kill Joorahmaar

I killed the wounded Dragon while Tharn destroyed the aegis and removed the magic that protected the island. Kaalgrontiid, meanwhile, caused the island to start to rise into the sky. We need to find a way off Dragonhold before it shakes itself apart. Escape Dragonhold

Abnur Tharn created a portal to get me off the island, but he remained behind. Dragonhold has risen into the sky. I need to find Khamira and Sai Sahan and let them know what happened. Find Khamira and Sai Sahan
Tharn's portal deposited me on the coast of Southern Elsweyr, where I met up with Khamira and Sai Sahan. I should tell Khamira what happened. Talk to Khamira
Sai Sahan and Khamira want to regroup at the Dragonguard Sanctum to gather our forces and make plans to assault Dragonhold. Go to Nahfahlaar's Chamber
Sai Sahan and Khamira seem at a loss for how to get the Dragonguard to the island. I should talk to Sai and see if I can help. Talk to Sai Sahan
Reality is torn and the Moon Beast approaches
Face Ravith-morna before she can summon a moon beast.
Weeping Wind Cave, Khenarthi's Rise, Star Haven Adeptorium, The Great Darkness, Tomb of Zerith-var

Zerith's gauntlet beckons him to Khenarthi's Rise, a place that was ruins even in his day. I should help him investigate this unusual summons, as he feels it might relate to our goal to stop Ravith-morna.
Krin'ze may not react to you any more than she does Zerith-var, only resetting her animation to the begin position upon interaction
The entrance to Khenarthi's Rise lies in Weeping Wind Cave in Reaper's March. I should search there with Zerith for an entrance to the ruins. Search Weeping Wind Cave
We found the passage to Khenarthi's Rise. Now to head to the ruins. Go to Khenarthi's Rise
Zerith and I reached Khenarthi's Rise. Zerith senses Cantor Krin'ze nearby. We should search for her and find out what she's doing here. Search for Cantor Krin'ze
Zerith and I found Cantor Krin'ze in some sort of trance. I should see if I can learn more about what happened to her. Examine Cantor Krin'ze
The spirit of Moon-Singer Talbira appeared and instructed us to repair and restore Khenarthi's Rise. I should speak to Zerith about how we go about such a task. Talk to Zerith-var

Zerith and I were instructed by the spirit of Moon-Singer Talbira to bring order to Khenarthi's Rise to reveal our path forward. I should search the ruins with Zerith and see what we can do. Restore Khenarthi's Rise: 0/3
The Scroll Repository Recover the Scrolls Return the Scrolls Talk to Zerith-var in the Scroll Repository
The Armory Find Moon-Sugar Water Anoint the Weapons Talk to Zerith-var in the Armory
The Grave Gather the Remains Place the Remains Bury the Remains Talk to Zerith-var at the Grave
Zerith and I did what we could to restore the training grounds of Khenarthi's Rise. We should return to Cantor Krin'ze and see if we can talk to her now. Talk to Cantor Krin'ze

Cantor Krin'ze had a revelation about Zerith's tie to Ravith-morna while she communed with the spirits in Khenarthi's Rise. I should speak to him about her notion that he has to apply Azurah's lesson of forgiveness to himself. Talk to Zerith-var

We need to find where Ravith-morna has fled to before she enacts her plan. I should pour the remaining moon-sugar water we found in Khenarthi's Rise into the ritual basin to assist Zerith in his efforts to find her. Pour the Moon-Sugar Water
I assisted Zerith with a ritual to help us find Ravith-morna. I should listen to where Azurah guides him. Listen to Zerith-var
Zerith opened a portal to where Azurah directed him to find Ravith-morna. I should enter the portal with Zerith and Cantor Krin'ze and go to Star Haven Adeptorium. Go to Star Haven Adeptorium

We arrived to Star Haven Adeptorium, but the Inquisitors made it here before us. It doesn't seem like they fared well against Ravith's Chorus, but Cantor Krin'ze seems particularly upset. I should talk to her before we rush in. Talk to Cantor Krin'ze
Cantor Krin'ze suspects the Inquisitors brought the Twilight Cantors to Star Haven Adeptorium and now they're in trouble. I should work with Zerith to search for them. Search for the Twilight Cantors
Zerith and I found High Cantor Viti in Star Haven Adpetorium. I should speak to her and see if she can help us locate any other surviving Twilight Cantors. Talk to High Cantor Viti

High Cantor Viti told us there are other Twilight Cantors currently being threatened by Ravith's Chorus. Zerith and I need to save them. Save the Twilight Cantors: 0/3 Talk to Cantor Nari Talk to Cantor Tharis-jo Talk to Cantor Cer'enza

Zerith and I saved the surviving Twilight Cantors from Ravith's Chorus. Zerith felt a pull from his moonclaw to the south side of Star Haven Adeptorium. We should search there for Ravith-morna. Search for Ravith-morna
Zerith and I saw a large tear open in the sky over Star Haven Adeptorium. I should ask him what this means. Talk to Zerith-var
Zerith says Ravith-morna has opened a tear in the planes in order to send her moon beast to Azurah's Crossing. We need to get closer and find Ravith-morna. Find Ravith-morna
Zerith-var, Cantor Krin'ze, and I are ready to enter the portal to the Great Darkness, where Ravith-morna works to awaken her moon beast. Enter the Portal to the Great Darkness
Zerith-var, Cantor Krin'ze and I entered the portal to the Great Darkness. Now we need to find our way to Ravith-morna. Find Ravith-morna
We found Ravith-morna. I need to work with Zerith and Cantor Krin'ze to defeat her. Defeat Ravith-morna
We defeated Ravith-morna, but were too late to stop the moon beast from being summoned. Together, Zerith and I can banish it. I need to help him. Banish the Moon Beast
Zerith and I banished the moon beast. I should listen while Zerith converses with Ravith, her spirit purified. Listen to Zerith and Ravith
I should enter the portal back to Nirn with Zerith and Cantor Krin'ze. Enter the Portal to Return to Reaper's March
Zerith seems to have fulfilled Azurah's purpose in sending him to this day and age. I should speak to him about what comes next. Talk to Zerith-var
I should talk to Zerith-var. Talk to Zerith-var
Delve deep beneath the Reach with Count Verandis
Search for the truth about the Dark Heart.
Gwendis at Rebel's Retreat or by the Markarth Wayshrine
Blackreach: Arkthzand Cavern, Chamber of the Dark Heart, Markarth, Nighthollow Keep
Black Diamond Pendant 1 Skill Point h Gold Achievement: Nighthollow Explorer
Verandis detected a growing concentration of dark energy-Void energy-within Nighthollow Keep. Perhaps we'll find the Dark Heart somewhere within those ancient ruins.
You can ask him a few questions before you go.

:"Let's you and I split up and search the keep while Gwendis returns to Markarth. We know Lady Belain has something in mind for the city and one of us should be close at hand. Inside, look for personal items. I can use them to glean information.":How will personal items help you learn anything about Nighthollow Keep?:"One of my talents involves auramancy magic. Certain inanimate objects, especially items that hold significant personal value, can become imbued with the auras of those who possessed them. Sometimes I can read vague impressions. Sometimes … more.":Tell me more about auramancy.::"Important events and powerful emotions leave a mark on their surroundings. Auramancy deals with evoking memories from the auras left behind on objects. It's an arcane art that I have perfected over the centuries. It often helps me in my work."::How do you think it will help us here?::"Auramancy is a useful tool for unraveling the history of ancient places. Clearly this keep was once great. Now it's forgotten, yet a power our enemies covet stirs within. I think the story of this place is the story of the Dark Heart.":Could these Nighthollow vampires be related to Rada al-Saran?::"I don't see how. Rada al-Saran was a Yokudan swordmaster before he came to Tamriel. His vampirism is the result of a meeting with Molag Bal. At least, that's how I understand it. Lady Belain, however. Her origins are unknown to me."::Is that why the search for the Dark Heart is leading us to Nighthollow Keep?::"A good question. We know that Rada promises freedom to the Gray Host. He spent centuries bringing the various elements of his plan together. How the Nighthollow fit in, I can't say. At least not yet. Hopefully, the answers await us in the keep."
You can ask him a few questions before progressing.

:"More than likely, the Dark Halls lie below us somewhere. See if you can find a way down while I attempt to trace the currents of void energy that radiate throughout this ruin. One of us should find a way through.":Vampires, Dwarves, Reach witches … who does the Dark Heart really belong to?:"The best answer may be none of them. I suspect the Dark Heart may have been here before all of them. More than likely, they found it and made use of it. Across the ages, different people may have been drawn to its power. We may never know for sure.":Do you think it drew Rada al-Saran?:"Perhaps. Curious, isn't it? I wonder if the Dark Heart has a purpose of its own. We better keep going. Until we actually find this thing, all we have are guesses."
The amulet use animation is missing when undoing the ward before the Dark Heart Chamber.
A dark red mist cloud persists where Rada al-Saran was, even after he is gone from the Dark Heart Chamber, and flickers in and out of view.
Gwendis asked me to meet Verandis at Nighthollow Keep, an ancient vampire fortress in Blackreach. The Dark Heart may be hidden somewhere inside. Go to Nighthollow Keep
I met Verandis on the way to Nighthollow Keep. I should talk to him. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch

As we search Nighthollow Keep, Verandis wants me to look for personal objects that he can use his auramancy on to get impressions of what happened here and how it relates to the Dark Heart. Explore Nighthollow Keep
I wandered into an old study in Nighthollow Keep. I should search it for something Verandis can use to attempt to draw a memory from. Search the Nighthollow Study
I found a damaged insignia of some sort in the keep's study. I should ask Verandis whether this is a suitable target for his auramancy. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch
Verandis thinks he can coax a memory from the emotional aura clinging to this insignia. I should observe anything that appears. Observe the Auramancy Magic

The memory conjured from the insignia showed Lady Belain and another Nighthollow vampire talking about drinking from the Dark Heart. I should see what Verandis thinks of this revelation. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch

Verandis wants me to continue to explore. While the magic he cast on the damaged insignia might reveal more memories, he wants me to find an undamaged one. He also suggested the place may contain void portals that will help me navigate the keep. Explore Nighthollow Keep Kill Lady

I found a relatively undamaged portion of the keep. It looks like a noble's personal chamber. I should search the area for objects that Verandis can cast his auramancy upon. Explore the Nighthollow Suite
I found an undamaged insignia in the Nighthollow suite. I should ask Verandis to try his auramancy magic on this new insignia. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch
I should watch and see what memory Verandis can draw from the insignia with his auramancy magic. Observe the Auramancy Magic
I observed another Nighthollow memory conjured by Verandis's aurumancy. I should talk to Verandis about this latest memory. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch

Verandis and I learned that the Nighthollow vampires accessed the Dark Heart through a passage they called the Dark Halls. I should continue to explore the keep in search of this passage. Find the Path to the Dark Heart Find the Entrance to the Dark Halls

Verandis and I have found the passage to the Dark Halls, but the way is blocked by powerful magic. Verandis wants to try to draw a memory from this location with his auramancy. I should watch and see what happens. Observe the Auramancy Magic

At the entrance to the Dark Halls Verandis conjured an old memory of Rada al-Saran and Lady Belain discussing the Dark Heart. I should talk to Verandis about this latest memory. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch
Verandis wants me to use the intact insignia and see if it opens the way to the Dark Halls. Dispel the Ward
The way is open. Now to explore the Dark Halls and see if we can find the Dark Heart. Explore the Dark Halls

Verandis and I found a small shrine deep in the Dark Halls. The personal items left here seem to be good candidates for his auramancy. I should watch whatever memory Verandis is able to reveal. Observe the Auramancy Magic
It appears that when the Dark Heart began to slow many centuries ago, Lady Belain took the last of the power for herself. I should talk to Verandis about this. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch
Another magical barrier guards the end of the Dark Halls. I should use the intact insignia to dispel it as I did at the entrance to this passage. The Dark Heart must be close. Dispel the Ward
With the last ward dispelled, I should head through the door and try to find the Dark Heart. Enter the Dark Heart Chamber

We reached the chamber containing the Dark Heart, but Rada al-Saran and Lady Belain are already here. While Verandis attempts to stop Rada al-Saran, I need to keep Lady Belain's Nighthollow minions away from him. Protect Count Verandis Ravenwatch
The Dark Heart has awakened and is rising upward, but Rada al- and Lady Belain have gotten away. I should check on Verandis. Go to Count Verandis Ravenwatch
The Dark Heart has awakened. I should talk to Verandis and find out what we should do now. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch
I need to follow Verandis and leave the Dark Heart chamber. Leave the Dark Heart Chamber
The lift took me to an overlook across from the Library of Arkthzand. The orrery dome is now glowing. I should talk to Verandis. Talk to Count Verandis Ravenwatch

"An ever-changing landscape of fire and storm, of disaster personified and unending destruction, this is the domain of Mehrunes Dagon, Prince of Ambition and Lord of Flood and Flame. Behold its glory and bow before our Lord!"-Valkynaz Nokvroz
The following Points of Interest do not count towards Zone Completion:
The situation is beginning to escalate...
Stop the Worm Cult from raiding a Stone-Nest necropolis.
Stirk Battletunic 1 Skill Point Achievement: Beneath Stone and Story vh Gold
I learned that the Worm Cult is planning to raid a Stone-Nest necropolis to raise an army of undead. And Vanus Galerion may be imprisoned there as well. I need to stop the cult and rescue Vanus.
Then come with us to Xul-Haj and help us stop them from raising an undead army.
I'm sorry for those you lost, Jeetra, but if you want vengeance, come with us to Xul-Haj.
The Worm Cult needs to pay for this atrocity. Come with us and together we'll spill their blood.
Darien, you didn't fail her. You weren't even here when she made her decision.
Darien, this isn't what Gabrielle wanted. She saved you so you could help us stop Mannimarco.
Listen to yourself. You sound pathetic! Is this really the person that Gabrielle gave her life for?
Prince Azah is not at his quest marker after completing the final stage of the quest.
Vanus has been taken to a ritual site in an Argonian xanmeer. I should speak with Jeetra and see if she can point us at the correct location. Talk to Jeetra
Jeetra believes the tomb the Worm Cult seeks is the ancient necropolis of Xul-Haj. I should meet her at her village, which is near the xanmeer tomb. Go to Jeetra's Village
Darien met me at the village, but something has happened here. We should look around. Investigate Village
We don't see Jeetra's body among the dead. I should look around and see if I can find her. Find Jeetra
Jeetra agreed to join us at Xul-Haj and help us stop the Worm Cult from raising an undead army and rescue Vanus Galerion. I should meet her there. Go to Xul-Haj
I met Jeetra and Darien at the entrance to Xul-Haj. We need to enter the ruins to stop the Worm Cult and rescue Vanus Galerion. Enter Xul-Haj
We entered the Xul-Haj ruins. Now to look around and try to find the Worm Cult and Vanus. Explore Xul-Haj
A ward blocks the door leading to the deep tombs. I should talk to Jeetra and see if she knows another way to get there. Talk to Jeetra
Gabrielle's voice led Darien into a trap. Now we need to search Xul-Haj not just for a way to reach the deep tombs, but in order to find Darien. Explore Xul-Haj

As we made our way toward the deep tombs, a spirit materialized before us and pointed out Darien across the way. Now it seems like it wants to speak to us. I should talk to it. Talk to the Xul-Haj Spirit

The Worm Cult tampered with the water levels in the xanmeer, cutting off our access to the deep tombs. We need to head to the sacred wellsprings and find a way to raise the water levels again. Reach the Wellspring

The Worm Cult moved the sacred wellspring stones and stopped the flow of water from the wellspring. I need to put the stones back into their proper position to restore the flow of water. Talk to Jeetra Move the Sacred Stones
I restored the flow of water to flood the chambers. I should return to the cistern chamber and see if we can move forward now. Return to the Cistern Chamber

Apparently, we need to locate another wellspring to get the water level to the right depth for us to reach Darien and the deep tombs. I need to explore the way ahead to find the next wellspring. Explore Xul-Haj
We need to find a second wellspring to release more water into the chambers. Reach the Wellspring
I need to move the sacred stones to release the waters of this wellspring and fully flood the chambers. Move the Sacred Stones
I released water from the second wellspring. Now to return to the cistern chamber and see if we can reach Darien. Search for Darien
Darien, mad with grief, fled deeper into the xanmeer to follow the false spirit. Now that we have restored the water from the wellsprings, I need to follow him. Rescue Darien
I rescued Darien from a false spirit that turned out to be a Harvester. Now I should talk to him. Talk to Darien
Now that Darien is back with us, we need to find Vanus and stop the Worm Cult ritual. Find Vanus Galerion

The note near Deredrien's body is from a mysterious figure called the Reformer, who is also after Sharp. I should talk to Sharp to see what's next. Talk to Sharp

Sharp and I found Mevei Andros. I should ask her about Reynila and warn her about the notes we found regarding her and Reynila. Talk to Mevei Andros

Reynila looks to be in her last moments alive. I should talk to her and see if anything can be done. Talk to Reynila

Dimik-ei seems lost without Reynila, but she recognizes Sharp. I should talk to Sharp about what comes next. Talk to Sharp
I helped mercenary Sharp-as-Night track down Reynila Treviri, but her death left him with more questions than answers. I should seek my reward and ask Sharp what he's planned next. Talk to Sharp

Sai Sahan awaits me in front of the Senchal Palace. I should speak to him. Talk to Sai Sahan
General Renmus, leader of Senchal's military forces, could get us the boat we need. I should hear how Sai plans to get us a meeting with the general. Talk to Sai Sahan

General Renmus dismissed Sai Sahan's request. I should speak to the general and see if I can convince him to arrange our passage to the Dragon's island. Talk to General Renmus

General Renmus refused our request, citing his lack of resources during these troubled times. We must find another way to reach the island. I should speak to Sai outside and see if he has any ideas. Meet Sai Sahan Outside
Aeliah Renmus, the general's daughter, approached us. I should see what she wants. Talk to Aeliah Renmus

I found Za'ji and his first mate Caska. I should see if he will agree to sail us to the Dragon's island lair. Talk to Za'ji

Za'ji will sail us to the Dragon's lair if we help him recover his beloved ship, the Perfect Pounce. He believes we'll find the mer who stole it in South Guard Ruins. I should head there now. Go to South Guard Ruins
Za'ji and Caska can't agree on a course of action for capturing Nartise Merys, the mer who Za'ji believes stole his ship. I should speak to Sai Sahan about our next move. Talk to Sai Sahan

We found Nartise, but he fled into a tunnel and locked the door behind him. I should wait for Sai to determine a course of action. Wait for Sai Sahan
Sai smashed the trap door open. Now we can follow Nartise into the tunnel below. I should continue my pursuit. Pursue Nartise Merys
Za'ji has suspended Nartise with magic. I should see if Nartise knows where we can find the Perfect Pounce. Talk to Nartise Merys
Nartise revealed that he sold the boat to the slaver Admiral Irathi. Now that the Dark Elf has revealed his betrayal, Za'ji seems to have plans for his former crew member. Talk to Za'ji
Za'ji catapulted Nartise deep into the sea. I should speak to him about what just occurred. Talk to Za'ji
Nartise claimed that the Perfect Pounce is docked nearby. I should speak to Sai Sahan about our next step. Talk to Sai Sahan
Sai and Za'ji will draw away as many slavers as they can. Meanwhile, Caska and I will secure the Perfect Pounce. I should head to the docks and look for the ship. Find the Perfect Pounce
Admiral Irathi has locked the ship's wheel with thick chains. I should get rid of the chains and secure the ship until Za'ji and Sai return. Seize the Perfect Pounce
Now that Caska and I have secured the Perfect Pounce, I must wait for Sai and Za'ji to board the ship. Wait for Za'ji to Board
Before we depart for the Dragon's island lair, we need to pick up Za'ji's crew. I should sail the ship to Senchal. Return Ship to Senchal
Aeliah has boarded the Perfect Pounce. I should speak to her. Talk to Aeliah Renmus
Za'ji's crew is on board and ready to set sail. I should speak to Sai about our departure. Talk to Sai Sahan
Za'ji's crew is on board and ready to set sail. I should speak to Sai when I'm ready to depart. Sail to the Island

While Sai, Caska, and Aeliah enter the ruins directly, I need to see where a nearby cavern leads. I should head to the cavern now and begin my search for the Dragon. Search for the Dragon
With my help, Sai and the others safely traversed the ruins. I should speak to him about our next step. Talk to Sai Sahan

Sai believes the ruins are actually a Dragonguard sanctuary. With that revelation in mind, he's more determined than ever to slay this Dragon. I should follow him to the chamber ahead and search for the Dragon. Enter the Dragonguard Chamber
Sai and I entered the chamber. We should search for the Dragon and prepare to fight the beast. Find the Dragon
The Dragon was unaffected by the Horn of Ja'darri and now wishes to speak with us. Sai wants to keep his guard up in case the beast attacks. I should speak with the Dragon. Talk to Dragon
The Dragon Nahfahlaar requested an alliance to defeat his brother Laatvulon. I should speak to Sai about this turn of events. Talk to Sai Sahan

Sai and I discovered ruins covered with grappling points. I should see what he thinks about all this. Talk to Sai Sahan

I found the Dark Water Temple's archives, but there's no sign of the Horn of Ja'darri. I should see if I can find any information about the Dragonhorn. Search for Clues About the Horn of Ja'darri
